scenes.title: 11:00 AM — Tapri, Cutting, Aur Ek Envelope
narration: *Subah 11. Tapri ke 4 plastic stool par dhoop adhi-adhi padi hai. Gujju ne apni nayi bat table par rakhi hai — 12,000 wali — aur uska cover abhi bhi chamak raha hai.*
Gujju: "Bro, sit down. Main dushmani nahi kar raha. Main bas risk manage kar raha hoon."
*Woh ek envelope tumhare thali ke neeche sarkata hai. 50 hazaar. Tum unhein gin nahi paate, par tumhe thickness se pata chal jaata hai ki sach mein hain.*
Gujju: "Bas ek kaam. Last over mat daal. Tu slow left-arm, meri off side kamzor — mujhe pata hai. Ek over. 50 hazaar. Aur academy seat: tu, Chintu, aur... Zoya ko bhi le lena."
*Aur theek peeche se ek awaaz — Chintu, notebook god mein, pencil hawa mein ruki hui.*
Chintu: "11:07. Maine likh liya. Gujju bhaiya, aapke envelope ka number bhi likh liya — 47,900. 100 kam hain, aapke baap ne 100 kaata."
*Tapri ke bahar, dhoop mein, Zoya khadi hai — usne sab sun liya hai. Woh kuch nahi bolti. Sirf ek cutting mangwati hai, aur aadha glass tumhari taraf sarka deti hai.*
Zoya: "Pani ki jagah ye pi le. Par faisla jaldi kar — final mein 6 balls mein nahi, aaj subah mein hota hai."
fallbackLines: *Gujju hansta hai, par uski aankhein nahi hansti. 'Value addition, bro' bolta hai aur jaane lagta hai.*
Anwar: "Beta, yahan chai 10 rupaye ki hai aur soch 10 lakh ki. Dono ka hisaab table par mat chhodna."
*Ramakaka ki chappal dukaan se glue ki smell aati hai. Coach ne kuch nahi dekha. Par uska kit-bag aaj khula pada hai — aur 1994 ki ball upar rakhi hai. Jaan-boojhkar.*

scenes.title: Semi: 4 Wickets, Ek Injury, Ek Number
narration: *Dopahar 1:30. Semi-final, Qureshi Hardware ke against. Maidan bhar gaya hai — 400 log, 60 chair, 3 kutte jo boundary par apni line bana chuke hain.*

*Tum 3 over daalte ho: 1 wicket, 11 runs. Beech mein ek chhota sa kalesh: Quresji ka bhai kehta hai 'teri team mein ladki kyun hai, aur wo bhi opener'. Zoya sun leti hai, aur usi over mein cover drive maarti hai — boundary, seedha line. Koi nahi chillata. Koi nahi zaroorat samajhta.*
Chintu: "Sher 176/4, 18 over. Zoya 71. Target: 179. Qureshi ka scoreboard 3 din se kharab hai, par main theek hoon."
*Aakhri ball par Ramakaka tumhare kaan mein bolta hai: 'Over karne se pehle ek sawaal poochh — tu kiska darr raha hai?'*
*Jeet jaati ho. 4 wicket. Maidan 40 second ke liye ek hi awaaz mein: 'GA-LI KE SHER!'. Gujju boundary ke paas khada hai, haath mein phone, aur woh video bana raha hai — mubarakbaad ke liye nahi.*
Zoya: "Final mein 200 honge. Unka plan: last over mein 3 boundary, aur ek bowler jo thaka ho. Tu unka plan hai, {{playerName}}."
fallbackLines: *Qureshi ka captain tumse haath milata hai aur kehta hai: 'Bhai, ladki ne tujhse zyada mari. Izzat uski ho rahi hai.' Zoya hasti hai — pehli baar aaj.*
Coach Ramakaka: "Theek. Ab ghar jao, 6 ghante so jao. Aur haan — envelope ko jeb mein mat rakhna. Jeb mein soch rakhna."
*Chintu apne notebook mein ek line likhta hai aur phaadkar tumhe de deta hai: 'Final: 200. Balls: 6. Runs: 12. Dono raaste khule hain.'*

scenes.title: Chhatri Ke Neeche Ka Court
narration: *Committee ka table: 2 plastic chairs, ek chhatri, aur ek file jispar 'Ground Sanction — Ramnagar Maidan' likha hai, 3 saal se ruka hua. Tum envelope rakhte ho.*
Committee Uncle: "Beta... ise kholna zaroori hai? Gujjar Builders is maidan ki light lagwata hai. Aur final 4 ghante mein hai."
*Gujju 30 second mein aata hai — bina gusse ke, haath mein chai. Woh committee ke samne envelope kholta hai, 100 rupaye kam hain, aur woh haste hue kehta hai:*
Gujju: "Sir, ye toh team welfare ka advance tha. {{playerName}} ko academy seat ke liye. Dekhiye, mere paas WhatsApp hai."

*Zoya, jo bahar khadi hai, andar aati hai. Bina bole Chintu ka notebook leti hai aur page 41 committee ke table par rakhti hai: 11:07, envelope, 47,900, aur ek line Chintu ke haath se: 'Note: 100 rupaye ka difference bhi likha hai, sir.'*
Chintu: "Maine 307 matches likhe hain, sir. Ek bhi galat nahi. Aap mujhe jhootha bol sakte ho, par 6 saal ka record nahi mita sakte."
*Committee uncle pen uthate hain. Light 6:45 band hogi. Match abhi bhi hoga. Par ab kisi ko pata hai ki aaj scoreboard hi court hoga.*
fallbackLines: Coach Ramakaka: "Theek. Ab jaao. Ek baat — jo likha hai, woh hata nahi jaayega. Achha bhi hai."
*Gujju tumhare paas se guzarte waqt kehta hai: 'Bro, ab toh tu jeetega nahi. Tere paas mera dushmani ka reason hai, meri nahi.' Uski awaaz pehli baar tight hai.*
*Maidan ke bahar 3 auto-wale committee se poochh rahe hain: 'Kya hua?'. Kisi ko jawab nahi milta. Aaj ke baad har Sunday ko milna chahiye tha.*

scenes.title: 200 Ka Target, 6 Balls
narration: *4:30 PM. Final. Gujjar Builders ne 200/6 banaye — 18 overs mein, 3 boundary last 2 over mein, aur ek over jismein 14 runs extra aaye (2 no-balls, 4 wides, 1 bye). Chintu ne sab likha. Maidan ke 500 log sab jaante hain.*

Gujju: "Bro, tu over daal. Tu daalenge, 12 banenge, aur tu 'imaandaar hero' rahega. Sab theek. Value addition, no drama."

*Ramakaka boundary se chillata hai, awaaz dheemi par poori hall mein: '{{playerName}}. 3 over bache hain. Daalna hai toh tu daal. Nahi daalna toh seedha bol — main Chotu ko bhej dunga. Koi sharam ki baat nahi.'*
*Zoya non-strike par khadi hai, bat kandhe par. Woh sirf ek line bolti hai.*
Zoya: "Tere 3 plans hain. Unka plan ek hai: tu thaka hua, aur tu darrta hua. Dono choose mat kar."
fallbackLines: *Aur phir Chintu ek ajeeb cheez karta hai: woh scoreboard par '12' nahi likhta. Woh '11' likhta hai — Nani Cup record. 'Taaki log record dekhein, aur tu history'.*

*Gujju phone par type karta hai. Tum dekh lete ho: 'over 1 — 0 runs allowed' nahi, balki 'arjun 12 done, pay 47.9k'. Usne bhej diya hai. Ab uske paas waapas nahi.*

Coach Ramakaka: "Ek line aur: teri maa ne 2017 mein mujhse kaha tha 'is bachche ko jeetna sikhao, haar mat sikhao'. Main donon kar chuka hoon. Ab tu jeet. Apni shart par."

fallbackLines: *Kahani poori — 6 balls, 13 runs, aur ek khaali panna bhar gaya.*

scenes.title: 3 Run Se Jeet, 1 Baat Se Haar
narration: *Aakhri ball par tum 4 ke bajaye 2 dete ho — aur Gujju ke batsman ko run-out karne ki race mein Zoya ka throw seedha gate se takraata hai. Umpire (committee uncle) 4 second mein 'NOT OUT' bolte hain. Super over. 6 balls. 9 runs. Haar.*
*Maidan ek minute chup rehta hai. Phir, ajeeb baat: log taali bajate hain. Na jeet ke liye. Isliye ki koi nahi gira, koi nahi roya, aur koi nahi bhaaga.*
Gujju: "Bro. Good game."
*aur woh sach mein keh raha hai — pehli baar aaj*
*Chintu apna notebook committee ke table par rakhta hai. Page 41 par 11:07 likha hai. Committee uncle use dekhte hain, 30 second, phir register kholte hain.*
*Aaj raad: investigation. Cup nahi mila, par maidan ki zameen ki file 'under audit' ho jaati hai. Aur Ramakaka aaj pehli baar 'theek' nahi bolte — woh kehte hain: 'Achha. Abhi ke liye achha.'*
*Super over haarne ke 2 hafte baad, team 3 naye nets paati hai. Ek par Zoya ke papa ka naam likha hai — 'donor', kyunki unhone 6 mahine ki shift chhutti leli.*
fallbackLines: *Kahani poori — jeet nahi, par sar utha ke. Abhi tak.*

scenes.title: Trophy Bina Naam
narration: *Cup Gujjar Builders ke haath jaata hai. Unki reel 40 lakh views karti hai. Tumhari 47,900 bank mein jaati hai, aur maidan ki baat khatam.*
*Agle din: Ramakaka ki dukaan band. Coach ne resignation nahi diya — woh sirf ek line likhkar gaya: 'Team ab tujhe chalayegi. Cup nahi, chunav.'*

*Zoya ne final nahi khela — 3 over mein woh out ho gayi. Uske 71 ka record ab 'incomplete' kehlaata hai, aur maidan ke 4 uncle aaj bhi wahi kehte hain: 'ladki thi, chhod dena chahiye tha'. Sunne mein ajeeb lagta hai — aur yahi sabse dard hota hai.*
Chintu: "{{playerName}} bhaiya. Aaj se main sirf ek copy likhunga. ...Doosri copy mein main likhunga ki kisne kya kaha. Taaki sach 6 saal baad bhi kharida na ja sake."

*3 mahine baad: 'Ramnagar Complex' ka board maidan ke upar khada hai. 4 families shift ho gayi — 2 unki marzi se, 2 bina. Aur ek 12 saal ka bachcha ab score nahi karta; uska notebook ab tumhare kamre mein hai, 307 match ka record, aur aakhri page par ek line: '12/6 — 11 record. Tune 13 de diye.'*
*Aur phir bhi — har Sunday subah 6:30, maidan ke uss chhote se hisse par jahan light nahi jaati, tum akela ball uchhaalte ho. Kyunki uss ek cheez mein aaj bhi kisi ko paisa nahi milta.*
fallbackLines: *Kahani poori — trophy mili, naam nahi.*

endings.title: Nani Cup, Khaali Panna Bhara
endings.description: Aakhri ball yorker, maidan 5000, aur Chintu ke haath se khoade gaye 2026 ke winners.

endings.title: 3 Run Se Jeet
endings.description: Super over haar gaye, par envelope ka sach maidan ke saamne aa gaya — aur zameen ki file 'under audit' ho gayi.

endings.title: Trophy Bina Naam
endings.description: Paisa aa gaya, coach gaya, maidan gaya. Ab sirf Sunday ki subah aur ek notebook ka aakhri panna.
